description: This file defines the ProjectActivityReportController class within the OrangeHRM Time module. It extends an abstract Vue controller and is responsible for preparing data properties for a project activity report component based on request query parameters, such as date range, project ID, and timesheet inclusion.

classes.name: ProjectActivityReportController
classes.description: Controller class that manages the preparation and rendering of data for the project activity report Vue component within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares visualization component with props based on incoming request query parameters such as date range, project ID, and timesheet inclusion flag.
